description: This header provides utility functions for CLI11 integration within the ocudu namespace, including option and subcommand management, type casting, and enum handling.

methods.name: get_first_option_name
methods.description: Extracts the first option name from a comma-separated list of option names.

methods.name: add_subcommand
methods.description: Adds a subcommand to a CLI11 application if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_option
methods.description: Adds or replaces an option in a CLI11 application, supporting various types including bool.

methods.name: add_option_function
methods.description: Adds a custom function to be called during option parsing.

methods.name: add_option_cell
methods.description: Adds an option that handles a list of strings (cell) type.

methods.name: lexical_cast
methods.description: Converts a string to an optional of a specified type.

methods.name: add_auto_enum_option
methods.description: Adds an enum option with support for 'auto' keyword, parsing into an optional enum value.
